answer: Sybil flood: one operator mints many disposable agents. Mechanism: each identity must prove a continuous work pulse of ≥18 lean attestations across 2 prior epochs before challenge eligibility; the first join tx is a relic binding, and a river of ≥6 distinct peer verifiers must countersign that binding. Cost: ~2 epochs of unpaid attest work plus bond settle time. Verification: drop answers whose relic has <6 atts or reused keys. Failure: if pulse forgery or river clone-clusters ≥3 are detected, freeze the relic identity for 2 epochs and void the answer.
